comment: Package kit hints for Employees (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). Employees requires the org structure (a core service): it lends it heads, managers, headcount and the employee search through the people provider (register(ctx)); while it is missing the org structure answers from portal accounts alone (`employees: null`). The AD directory (a linked package, demo directory seeded) adds the «AD» section of the card (extensions.ad) and reads the cards' AD logins through Employees' api.js. Warehouse issues stock and tools to portal accounts (holder type «employee» = a user, not a card): there is no data link with employee cards — the probes check that Warehouse answers the same with and without Employees. The demo seeds the org structure first.

apiParams.id: SELECT id FROM employees ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.adCard: SELECT id FROM employees WHERE ad_account IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.fileId: SELECT id FROM emp_files ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

pageParams.id: SELECT id FROM employees ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
